$$10^{100}S = \underbrace{\sum_{m=1}^{100}\tau(m)\,10^{100-m}}_{N\text{ (an integer)}} + \underbrace{\sum_{j=1}^\infty \tau(100+j)\,10^{-j}}_{T}.$$
